# Implementation and service issues

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| ** How to verify Kuailu ' s technical and service capabilities** | Verifiable materials include corresponding certificate knowledge points, product functionality information and a description of deployment capability. The size of the client, the service commitment and the impact of the case are based on the latest client account, contract or service level agreement and authorized case data, respectively. |
| ** Will the software be updated regularly? Does the upgrade require additional fees?** | Cloud-end versions will continue to overlap; the inclusion of upgrades, new functions or additional services will depend on the product purchased, the length of service and the contractual agreement. |
| **What implementation and after-sale services are offered by Kuailu?** | Support can be obtained through the online passenger service and service line of the official network; enterprise projects can be contracted for deployment, training, problem management and transportation services. The length of service, response time and range of delivery are governed by a contract or service-level agreement. |
| ** Will the template for industry scenarios be updated regularly? ** | Whether the template is updated, updated, frequency, availability and inclusion in the service depends on the product version, account number privileges and contractual agreement. |
| ** How do I support staff who are not familiar with the operation of the system?** | The pages and processes could be streamlined in conjunction with user roles, and training and guidance on their use could be arranged within the project; the form, frequency and ongoing support would be based on delivery programmes and contracts. |
